# Arakees

> All-in-one platform for independent consultants and coaches: website, online booking, client portal, proposals and invoicing. Set up for you, in your brand, on your own domain. Contact: https://www.arakees.com/contact

## Pages

- [Arakees · All-in-one CRM for independent consultants and coaches](https://www.arakees.com/): Website, online booking, client portal, proposals and invoicing in one platform, under your own brand. Built for independent consultants and coaches.
- [CRM, booking and invoicing for consultants · Arakees](https://www.arakees.com/product): Dashboard, sales pipeline, proposals, calendar, billing, client portal and website: everything an independent practice runs on, in one platform.
- [Client management software for coaches and consultants · Arakees](https://www.arakees.com/solutions): Arakees for consultants, coaches, trainers and small firms: proposals, booking, client portal and invoicing in one platform.
- [Arakees Care · Availability, security and confidentiality](https://www.arakees.com/care): Redundant EU hosting, encrypted backups with two providers, isolated data and personal follow-up for every Arakees platform.
- [How it works, pricing model and FAQ · Arakees](https://www.arakees.com/how-it-works): We set up your platform in your brand. Pricing: setup from €990 including a lifetime licence, then Arakees Care from €49 a month. Frequently asked questions.
- [Contact · Arakees](https://www.arakees.com/contact): Questions, a demo or getting started: write to Arakees through the contact form. We answer every message personally.
